coreRoles.title: Cloud Data & Analytics Engineer
coreRoles.targetAudience: Data analysts, database administrators, and software engineers transitioning to cloud data lakes and real-time streaming architectures.
coreRoles.shortDescription: Ingest, transform, and analyze exabyte-scale structured and streaming datasets with Athena, Glue, Redshift, and Kinesis.
coreRoles.suggestedExamPath: AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate → AWS Certified Data Engineer - Associate
coreRoles.capstoneLab: Real-Time Financial Telemetry Lakehouse: Amazon Data Firehose, Apache Iceberg on S3, AWS Glue & Redshift Serverless
coreRoles.marketingHook: No console clicking. Every lab is built, tested, and destroyed via code you can push straight to your GitHub.

modules.title: Modern Data Lakehouse on AWS S3 & Apache Iceberg
modules.foundation: Open table formats, ACID transactions on object storage, metadata management, and S3 partition layout strategies.
modules.implementation: Deploy an Apache Iceberg lakehouse on Amazon S3 using AWS Glue Catalog and Terraform, configuring schema evolution and time-travel queries.
modules.stressTest: Scenario Incident #401: Resolve an Iceberg metadata lock contention error caused by concurrent streaming writes during high-volume ingestion.
modules.professionalEdge: Resume Bullet (Example: replace with your own measured results): 'Designed Apache Iceberg lakehouse architecture on S3, cutting data query latency by 62% and reducing storage expenditure by $35k annually.'

labCostCard.costNote: Within AWS Free Tier or LocalStack emulation
labCostCard.servicesUsed: Lake Formation Permissions, ACID Transactions on S3, Parquet Columnar Partitioning

modules.title: Serverless ETL with AWS Glue & Dynamic Frames
modules.foundation: Distributed PySpark execution models, DynamicFrame optimizations, Glue Crawler cost control, and Job Bookmarks state preservation.
modules.implementation: Build an automated serverless ETL pipeline using AWS Glue 4.0 PySpark scripts, transforming uncompressed JSON into Snappy Parquet.
modules.stressTest: Scenario Incident #402: Triage a Glue job OOM (Out Of Memory) executor failure caused by skewed data partitions without increasing DPU capacity.
modules.professionalEdge: [Example: replace with your own measured results] Production PySpark ETL Template with automated data quality validation and schema enforcement.

labCostCard.costNote: Within AWS Free Tier or LocalStack emulation
labCostCard.servicesUsed: Glue Data Catalog & Crawlers, PySpark Distributed Transforms, Job Bookmarks for Incremental Data

modules.title: Real-Time Streaming Ingestion with Amazon Kinesis & MSK
modules.foundation: Partition keys, shard capacity mathematics, consumer lag, Kinesis Data Streams vs. Apache Kafka (MSK), and deduplication techniques.
modules.implementation: Deploy an auto-scaling Amazon Kinesis Data Stream with Lambda consumers and Amazon Data Firehose writing batch Parquet to S3 via Terraform.
modules.stressTest: Scenario Incident #403: Debug severe shard iterator age spikes caused by hot partition key hashing during a 10x traffic surge.
modules.professionalEdge: [Example: replace with your own measured results] Streaming Architecture Topology Package with documented buffer tuning (5MB / 300s) and backpressure handling.
topics: Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka

labCostCard.costNote: Within AWS Free Tier or LocalStack emulation
labCostCard.servicesUsed: Kinesis Shard Scaling, Amazon Data Firehose Buffering, Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka

modules.title: Serverless SQL Analytics with Amazon Athena & Presto
modules.foundation: Trino/Presto query engine internals, partition projection, cost reduction via columnar formats, and workgroup query limits.
modules.implementation: Configure Athena Workgroups with strict per-query data scan limits, CTAS table materialization, and automated query performance monitoring via CDK.
modules.stressTest: Scenario Incident #404: Optimize a runaway analytical query scanning 8 TB of unpartitioned data, slashing query execution time from 14 minutes to 11 seconds.
modules.professionalEdge: [Example: replace with your own measured results] Athena Query Cost Optimizer Playbook saving up to 90% on scanned analytical query billing.

labCostCard.costNote: Within AWS Free Tier or LocalStack emulation
labCostCard.servicesUsed: Partition Projection Mechanics, CTAS Materialized Results, Cost Reduction via Columnar Formats

modules.title: Cloud Data Warehousing with Amazon Redshift Serverless
modules.foundation: Columnar data storage, Distribution Styles (KEY, EVEN, ALL), Sort Keys (Compound vs. Interleaved), and Concurrency Scaling.
modules.implementation: Deploy Amazon Redshift Serverless with automated data loading from S3 via auto-copy, integrated with AWS Secrets Manager credentials.
modules.stressTest: Scenario Incident #405: Diagnose an analytical dashboard freeze caused by unvacuumed tables and sub-optimal distribution keys generating cross-slice network broadcast overhead.
modules.professionalEdge: [Example: replace with your own measured results] Enterprise Data Warehouse Design Blueprint with benchmarked SQL query performance comparisons.

labCostCard.costNote: Within AWS Free Tier or LocalStack emulation
labCostCard.servicesUsed: Distribution & Sort Key Strategies, Redshift Spectrum S3 Querying, Workload Management (WLM)

modules.title: Data Governance, Auditing & Lineage with Lake Formation
modules.foundation: Fine-grained access control (FGAC), cell-level security, column filtering, and regulatory compliance (GDPR/HIPAA) in data lakes.
modules.implementation: Configure AWS Lake Formation tag-based access control (TBAC) managing access permissions across Athena, Redshift Spectrum, and EMR via Terraform.
modules.stressTest: Scenario Incident #406: Audit and revoke unauthorized column-level access to sensitive customer PII without disrupting active automated BI reporting pipelines.
modules.professionalEdge: [Example: replace with your own measured results] Enterprise Data Governance & Audit Compliance Checklist ready for Chief Data Officer (CDO) architecture review.

labCostCard.costNote: Within AWS Free Tier or LocalStack emulation
labCostCard.servicesUsed: Column- and Row-Level Permissions, Data Filtering Policies, Data Lineage Tracking
